faqs.a: It's betting on a match while it is currently happening. Odds shift based on every ball bowled.

faqs.q: Why do odds change so fast?
faqs.a: Odds reflect the current probability. A wicket, a boundary, or even a bowling change triggers immediate updates on our exchange.

faqs.q: Is live betting riskier than pre-match?
faqs.a: It requires faster decision-making, but it offers more opportunities to trade in and out of a position for profit.

faqs.q: Can I watch the match and bet at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes. Most professional traders watch a live feed while keeping the Cricbet99 dashboard open for immediate trading.
